The 9-line fixture patch correctly and minimally addresses a real post-main race. The design.md establishes that external browser network is blocked and that digest generation can complete under those conditions; I did not perform a complete offline-provider provenance audit and cannot assert the precise origin of every alert that reached `generateDigest` in the hosted failure.

The `cb:show-digest` on-demand handshake synchronously cancels the pending idle/timeout callback (`cancelScheduledDigest()`), increments `digestGeneration`, aborts `digestAbortController`, and opens the overlay via `showStatus`. Close via `onDismiss` increments generation again and aborts — leaving no path for any later proactive `.then()` completion to reopen the overlay (guard: `controller.signal.aborted || generation !== this.digestGeneration`). Accessible names verified against `DigestOverlay.ts` source.
